litigation.note: Growel's 101 Mall (the Shoppertainment segment) was closed for all of FY2025-26. The closure follows a Maharashtra Pollution Control Board order of March 5, 2025, issued under the Water Act and the Air Act. The Bombay High Court upheld the order on March 19, 2025. The company has filed a Special Leave Petition in the Supreme Court, which is pending final adjudication; the matter is sub-judice and regulatory clearances are awaited (MD&A, Shoppertainment Segment and Outlook).
